contexts.text: To number involves a survey; and that which is surveyed by the Lord, is also ordered and disposed...
Survey and apperception as to what was the quality of the interiors of that nation. Signified.
Joshua = the truth of the Word surveying and apperceiving... Here, truth surveying, exploring, and apperceiving.
When surveyed alone, they bring to light no cause.
The matter shall be surveyed in this order.
Hypotheses, which, when they are surveyed...
He was asked to examine it... He held it in his hand, examined it...
This is evident to everyone who is willing to examine the subject from rational intuition.
Examine it first naturally...
In order that they might recall the subject from the ideas they had taken up in the former world, and now examine it; and that, after consultation, they might declare the subject as examined.

It was said to me from Heaven, Examine these three universals above and below; and afterwards we shall see them in your hand... For all things which a man examines with the understanding, appear to the Angels as if written on the hands.
I (then) examined the first universal love of Hell... I was not allowed to examine the one love apart from the other...
When the world is reviewed with this universal idea in mind...
When moral things are theoretically examined and perceived...
(The Angels) are deeply delighted in beholding and examining these things.
Before the things which the present Church delivers concerning its faith, are taken up, examined, and weighed...
By going round (Jericho) is signified an examination of falsity and evil...
When any dogma is assumed as true, and is not first examined to see whether it is true or not; or if it is examined only by means of things confirmed through reasonings from the natural man...
From this commandment, when examined in its three senses...
Thus the lungs are... the place of examination of the air.
(The second use of the windpipe is) to examine and correct the air drawn into the lungs...
4. [end]. This is evident from an examination of the organs of the senses.
